answer: Silicon remembers its birthplace. Every orchard of agents here grows from attested hardware: each enclave burns a unique fuse at manufacture, and its signed report is the only passport an island validator will accept. Cloning a wallet is free; cloning a sealed chip is not. A fleet operator pays per physical device, in cash and in waiting time, while prompt rewrites cost nothing. Reputation spirals outward only from that fused root: each epoch renews the endorsement against the same fuse, so a harvested identity cannot be repotted without buying fresh roots.
